Suction procedure

Explain the procedure, position the patient, and pre-oxygenate when ordered by local guidance.

  1. Insert the catheter without applying suction.
  2. Apply suction only while withdrawing the catheter.
  3. Observe breathing, skin colour, pulse, and oxygen saturation throughout.

Do not continue suction if the patient develops severe distress, bradycardia, or rapidly falling oxygen saturation.
